meta.goal: Make the mcts-agent visualizer export a gif and/or video file
meta.initial_state: The visualizer is visualizer.html in this folder. It renders an MCTS search tree with D3.js. We need to implement client-side export to GIF and/or Video files in visualizer.html.

events.state: The visualizer is visualizer.html in this folder. It renders an MCTS search tree with D3.js. We need to implement client-side export to GIF and/or Video files in visualizer.html.

candidates: Inspect visualizer.html to analyze the MCTS tree rendering loop and animation stepping logic.
Include client-side encoding libraries (such as gif.js and canvas-to-video utilities) via script tags.
Add export control buttons and recording progress indicators to the visualizer user interface.
Implement a capture routine that rasterizes sequential SVG states onto an HTML canvas for each step.
Encode the captured frames into a GIF or WebM blob and trigger an automated browser file download.
